questions.text: C35 / F50 mullions: geometry or texture? Measured: F50 caps protrude 20 mm beyond the glass face (profile x 78.76-79.05, glass 78.98-79.03; lower 76.09-76.38 vs 76.31-76.36). RECOMMENDATION: <= 5 cm -> texture (reg p.32 §7): the CW is a Main frame plane with one hole per panel, 50 mm strips carry the F50 cap texture (ID 12), glass is a flat MainGlass quad per panel inset 15 mm (WIN-01, WIN-11, D172). Parts > 5 cm stay geometry: ribs 430 mm (P10), sign frames 80 mm (P11), parapet caps 160 mm overhang (P12), base flashing 80 mm (P13). Cost: P05+P06+P07+P20 = 5 300 tris vs ~25 000 for modelled F50 profiles (2 200 source profile objects).
questions.answer: User 2026-11-04: GEOMETRY, not texture. F50 caps are simple boxes 50 mm wide, 20 mm proud of the frame plane, quads, welded into the CW relief without overlaps (P05/P06/P07); budgets raised accordingly.

questions.text: The FBX has no underside under the 2.86 m cantilever (z 4.70, x 76.17-79.03, whole E facade incl. corners) and no ceiling over the entrance niche (x 73.10-76.00, z 4.65): a visible hole. RECOMMENDATION: build P04 as one soffit face, ID 19 canopy RAL 1001 per sheet 18 'козырек над входом, метал. панели с фактурой дерева' and sheet 19 'пространство с навесом' - over the full cantilever length, not only the entrance. Alternative: 1001 only over the niche, ID 2 RAL 7021 elsewhere.
questions.answer: Accepted as recommended: soffit under the cantilever +4.70 and the niche ceiling built as wood ID 19 RAL 1001.

questions.text: Revolving door (D07): measured on sheet 25 at 1:200 (scale from axes 11-12 = 8.4 m): drum outer D 4.12 +-0.03 m, inner 3.74 m, centre x 73.08 / y -23.73 on the niche glass line; between the two niche doors (y -25.90..-21.58, 4.32 m clear). Height is not on any sheet. RECOMMENDATION: drum height 2.72 m (niche glass transom line z 2.72), flat canopy disc to 2.72, 4 wings, new library type revolving_door_D4120_H2720 before placement (TASK windows rule, D116).
questions.answer: Accepted as recommended: revolving door height 2.72 (niche transom line); library type ELV-17.
